description: Score a paper league from its files and prices, repeatable by anyone: each entrant's rank correlation with what followed, set against the best luck gives across that many entrants, how different each is from the rest, and a paper book of the top entrants chosen on earlier rounds only.

book_size.description: How many top entrants the paper book combines. Default 5.

prices_file.description: CSV: a date column and one column of closing prices per ticker. Everyone re-running the table needs the same file.

name: league_score
title: Score a paper league
